# Sravana S Parimi

> Senior Software Engineer III at Fifth Third Bank in Cincinnati, OH. Full-stack engineer and technical lead working with React, TypeScript, Java and Spring Boot. Also known as Sravan Parimi, Sravana Parimi, Sravana Subramanyam Parimi, and DevSravana on GitHub.

## Work
- [Enterprise application modernization](https://sravanasparimi.com/work/enterprise-application-modernization/): Fifth Third Bank. Modernizing banking operations interfaces with React, TypeScript, Java and Spring Boot; shared React component library with Storybook.
- [Produce specifications and inspections](https://sravanasparimi.com/work/produce-specifications-inspections/): Kroger. Web interfaces for produce specifications and quality inspections.
- [Employee timekeeping and leave](https://sravanasparimi.com/work/employee-timekeeping-leave/): FISA-OPA. React redesign of timekeeping and leave interfaces.
- [Retail eCommerce storefront](https://sravanasparimi.com/work/retail-ecommerce-storefront/): ICF Next Global. Storefront from discovery to checkout with Vue and Shopify Liquid.
- [Business and commerce web applications](https://sravanasparimi.com/work/business-commerce-web-applications/): Earth7 Consulting LLC. Interfaces and Java API integration with automated tests.
